info.title: Carbontrace Admin & REST API
info.description:
### Carbontrace API & Modular Documentation

This documentation covers all active REST API endpoints, web view renders, and SDK integration interfaces for Carbontrace Admin.

#### Navigation & Categorization:
- 🌐 **[Main Admin & REST APIs](/api-docs)**: Documented under `/api-docs` (modular tags for Auth, Sales, Billing, Accounts, Wallet, Rewards, etc.).
- 📦 **[CT-SDK & Public Integration APIs](/api-docs/sdk)**: Documented separately under `/api-docs/sdk` for client SDKs and public webhooks.
- 🎨 **[Web Views (EJS Renders)](/api-docs#/Web%20Views%20(EJS%20Renders))**: Documented under the `Web Views (EJS Renders)` tag to distinguish server-rendered pages from pure REST APIs.
